Copy-Item $jsonlFile.FullName $rrlPath -Force\n    Write-Host \"  COPIED: $rrlPath\"\n}\n\n$rrlText   = Get-Content $rrlPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8\n$rrlBytes  = (Get-Item $rrlPath).Length\n$rrlChars  = $rrlText.Length\n\n# FIDELITY GATE: verify RRL contains both speakers\n$hasUser      = $rrlText -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"user\"'\n$hasAssistant = $rrlText -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"assistant\"'\nif \"RRL SIZE WARN: $rrlBytes bytes (< 50KB) — expected full transcript. Check JSONL source.\"\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 1 ✓ RRL: $rrlPath — $rrlBytes bytes ($rrlChars chars)\"\n```\n\n**RRL is the ONLY hard stop. No JSONL source = exit 1. No RRL = no run = exit 1.**\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 2 — SOUL (ATOMIC RECEIPT)\n\nQuery ONCE before POST. POST. Query ONCE after. Store receipt. Never re-query.\nSource: user turns extracted from the RRL (not a separate hand-written file).\n\n```powershell\n$countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n\n# Post Michael's verbatim words from the RRL to soul-logger\n# SOUL = user turns only. \"\"\n$inAssistantBlock = $false\n\nforeach ($line in $lines) {\n    $trimmed = $line.Trim()\n    \n    # Detect role markers (JSONL format)\n    if ($trimmed -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"') {\n        # Save previous block if it was assistant\n        if ($inAssistantBlock -and $currentBlock.Trim().Length -gt 10) {\n            $turnSeq++\n            $text = $currentBlock.Trim()\n            run    = $run\n                seq    = $turnSeq\n                type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n                chars  = $text.Length\n                text   = $text\n            }\n        }\n        $currentRole = $matches[1]\n        $currentBlock = \"\"\n        $inAssistantBlock = ($currentRole -eq \"assistant\")\n    }\n    # Detect plain-text speaker markers\n    elseif ($trimmed -match '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]') {\n        if ($inAssistantBlock -and $currentBlock.Trim().Length -gt 10) {\n            $turnSeq++\n       $dnaRecords += [ordered]@{\n                run    = $run\n                seq    = $turnSeq\n                type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n                chars  = $text.Length\n                text   = $text\n            }\n        }\n        $inAssistantBlock = $true\n        $currentBlock = $trimmed -replace '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]\\s*', ''\n    }\n    # Accumulate lines within a block\n    elseif ($inAssistantBlock) {\n        $currentBlock += \"`n$line\"\n    }\n}\n\n# Flush final block\nif ($inAssistantBlock -and $currentBlock.Trim().Length -gt 10) {\n    $turnSeq++\n    $text = $currentBlock.Trim()\n    $isBlueprint = ($text -match '```|`````|fenced code block|\\b(SPEC|SPECIFICATION|BLUEPRINT|ARCHITECTURE|SCHEMA|DESIGN)\\b' -and $text.Length -gt 200)\n    $dnaRecords += [ordered]@{\n        run    = $run\n        seq    = $turnSeq\n        type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n        chars  = $text.Length\n        text   = $text\n    }\n}\n\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n# EC-026: DUAL-HASH DETERMINISM NORMALIZATION\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n# DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED:\n#   JSONL path (line ~190): role-marker line (\"role\":\"assistant\") is EXCLUDED from $currentBlock\n#   Plain-text path (line ~209): speaker-marker line (\"AGENT:\") is INCLUDED with prefix stripped\n#   Result: same semantic turn produces different character counts depending on which parser path was taken.\n# FIX: Normalize both paths — strip role-marker and speaker-prefix lines to empty before accumulation.\n#   After normalization, both paths should produce identical byte counts for the same semantic content.\n$dnaTotalCharsJsonl  = 0\n$dnaTotalCharsPlain  = 0\n$dnaJsonlRecords     = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.text -notmatch '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]' }).Count\n$dnaPlainRecords     = $dnaRecords.Count - $dnaJsonlRecords\nif ($dnaJsonlRecords -gt 0 -and $dnaPlainRecords -gt 0) {\n    $dnaTotalCharsJsonl = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.text -notmatch '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]' } | Measure-Object -Property chars -Sum).Sum\n    $dnaTotalCharsPlain = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.text -match '^(AGENT|OB1|ASSISTANT|Agent 99)\\s*[:|>-]' } | Measure-Object -Property chars -Sum).Sum\n}\nif ($dnaTotalCharsJsonl -gt 0 -and $dnaTotalCharsPlain -gt 0) {\n    $charDiff = [Math]::Abs($dnaTotalCharsJsonl - $dnaTotalCharsPlain)\n    $avgChars = ($dnaTotalCharsJsonl + $dnaTotalCharsPlain) / 2\n    if ($avgChars -gt 0) {\n        $pctDiff = ($charDiff / $avgChars) * 100\n        if ($pctDiff -gt 1.0) {\n            Write-Warning \"EC-026 DUAL-HASH DRIFT: JSONL-path chars=$dnaTotalCharsJsonl vs plain-path chars=$dnaTotalCharsPlain — diff $pctDiff% (>1%). DNA hash may not be deterministic across parser paths.\"\n        } else {\n            Write-Host \"  EC-026 OK: JSONL/plain char diff = $pctDiff% (within 1% tolerance)\"\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n$dnaCount = $dnaRecords.Count\n$dnaBlueprintCount = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" }).Count\n\nif ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n    $dnaPath = \"$dnaDir\\dna-run$run.json\"\n    $dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $dnaPath -Encoding UTF8\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ✓ DNA: $dnaCount records ($dnaBlueprintCount blueprints) → $dnaPath\"\n} else {\n    Write-Warning \"STAGE 3 ⚠ DNA_GAP — 0 assistant turns extracted from RRL\"\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n\n```powershell\n# --- Helper Functions ---\nfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        ForEach-Object { if ($_.Name -match 'HL-(\\d+)\\.json$') { [int]$matches[1] } }\n    if ($existing) { return ($existing | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum + 1 }\n    return 1\n}\nfunction Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n    if (-not $latest) { return $null }\n    $entry = Get-Content $latest.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\n    return $entry.merkle_hash\n}\nfunction Compute-Sha256 {\n    param([string]$InputString)\n    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n}\n\nif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n$parentHash = [ordered]@{\n    hl_id          = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n    session_id     = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n    rrl_source     = $rrlPath\n    char_count     = $rrlChars\n    byte_count     = $rrlBytes\n $timestamp\n    sov100         = $true\n    run            = $run\n}\n\n$ledgerPath = \"$ledgerDir\\HL-$nextHL.json\"\n$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 5 — STARMAP ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"prose\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"turn-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n} else { \"\" }\n\n$dnaTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n SOULKEYS (KEYWORD INDEX — SOUL + DNA, READ-MERGE-WRITE)\n\nExtract keywords over BOTH SOUL (user words) AND DNA (agent blueprints).\nNever `-Append` on JSON. Always read → merge in memory → overwrite.\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $keywordDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $keywordDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# Extract terms from both SOUL Any HOLLOW stage = GAP.\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 8 — REGISTRY SYNC (ART ARSENAL × SOULKEYS × STARMAP × LEDGER)\n\nCross-references this run's SOULKEYS against the art-arsenal registry.\nAny piece whose tags intersect the run's top keywords gets tagged with the run, HL ID, starmap pointer, and merkle hash.\nWrites a canonical artifact. ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n248\t# EC-026: DUAL-HASH DETERMINISM NORMALIZATION\n249\t# ═══════════════════════════════════════════\n250\t# DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED:\n251\t#   JSONL path STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n292\t\n293\t```powershell\n294\t# --- Helper Functions ---\n295\tfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n296\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n297\t return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n315\t}\n316\t\n317\tif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null { \"DNA_GAP\" }\n327\t\n328\t$ledgerHash = Compute-Sha256 \"$soulHash|$dnaHash|$parentHash|$timestamp\"\n329\t\n330\t$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{\n331\t    hl_id          = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n332\t Copy-Item $jsonlFile.FullName $rrlPath -Force\n93\t    Write-Host \"  COPIED: $rrlPath\"\n94\t}\n95\t\n96\t$rrlText   = Get-Content $rrlPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8\n97\t$rrlBytes  = (Get-Item Get-Next-LedgerID {\n232\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n233\t    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n234\t        ForEach-Object { Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n239\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n240\t    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n241\t    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath One run = one HL.\"\n261\t    exit 1\n262\t}\n263\t\n264\t$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n265\t$parentHash = Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n266\t\n267\t$timestamp = | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\n293\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n294\t```\n295\t\n296\t---\n297\t\n298\t## STAGE 5 — STARMAP (POINTER MAP — ANTI-BLOAT)\n299\t\n300\t```powershell\n301\tif (-not (Test-Path $starmapDir)) { Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n183\t\n184\t**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n185\t\n186\tAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n187\t\n188\t### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n189\t\n190\t`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n191\t\n192\t**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n193\t\n194\t### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n195\t\n196\t`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n197\t\n198\t**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n199\t\n200\t### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n201\t\n202\tPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n203\t\n204\t**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n205\t\n206\t### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n207\t\n208\tWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n224\t\n225\t**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n226\t\n227\tVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n228\t\n229\t### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n230\t\n231\tWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n652\t\n653\t### Fix Applied\n654\t**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n655\t1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n656\t2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n657\t3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n658\t\n659\t### What Was NOT Changed\n660\t- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n661\t- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n662\t- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n663\t- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n664\t\n665\t### Testing\n666\t- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n667\t- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n668\t- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n669\t- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n670\t\n671\t### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\n672\tAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n673\t\n674\t1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n675\t2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n676\t3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n677\t\n678\t### Remaining Known Issues\n679\t- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n680\t- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n681\t- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n682\t- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n683\t\n684\t---\n685\t\n686\t## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n687\t\n688\t### Overview\n689\tRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n690\t\n691\t---\n692\t\n693\t### 1. Total: up to 4-8 seconds before the LLM even started.\n\n**Fix:** Collapsed all 7 into a single `Promise.allSettled([...])` round — all fire simultaneously. Time = slowest single fetch, not the sum.\n\nAlso: `rosterStub.fetch()` and `updateStudentMemory()` were both `await`ed AFTER DeepSeek returned. Made fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => {})`).\n\n### Root Cause: Bilingual mode silently dropped\n\n`capContextInjection()` has a 1200-char hard cap. `vietnameseContext` was passed as the 8th argument — ledger/session/weakness filled the budget first, Vietnamese instruction was silently cut every time.\n\n**Fix:** `vietnameseContext` and `teachingFocusContext` now passed FIRST in `capContextInjection` — guaranteed never truncated.\n\n### Root Cause: teachingFocus never reached the server\n\n`handleChat()` only read `lang:<id>` from KV, never the student profile. `teachingFocus` (\"Speak VERY slowly, short sentences...\") was only available client-side, but the server-side prompt REPLACES the client's system prompt.\n\n**Fix:** `handleChat()` now reads `student_profile_<id>` from KV in parallel with `lang:<id>`, extracts `teachingFocus`, injects as `TEACHER INSTRUCTION` block.\n\n### Root Cause: isVague() matched \"anything\" as substring\n\nPattern `/anything|something|everything/` matched inside any sentence containing those words. Student saying \"Anything about health interests me\" triggered the \"Come on! Say something!\" scripted fallback instead of the LLM.\n\n**Fix:** Only match as standalone response: `/^(whatever|anything|something|everything)\\.?\\s*$/`\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Text routing\n\nWhen student types a message (fallback path), it now routes through the open Deepgram Voice Agent WS as `{type: \"TextInput\", text}` instead of hitting `/api/chat` → DeepSeek. Deepgram's in-house LLM responds via `ConversationText` event in ~200-500ms.\n\n- `agentTextResolve` promise pattern: `reactLLM()` sets resolver, `handleAgentMsg` resolves it on assistant `ConversationText`\n- 6-second timeout → falls back to REST if agent doesn't respond\n\n### Voice-First UI: magic-chat.html\n\nApp is a speaking trainer — text input removed from visible UI.\n- `#msg` input and `#sendBtn` hidden via CSS (`display: none`) — kept in DOM so JS refs don't break\n- `#mic` button made large (72×72px), centered, prominent\n- `#micStatus` text element added below mic button — shows: \"Tap to start\" / \"Connecting…\" / \"Listening…\" / \"Processing…\"\n- `#mic.mic-active` pulsing purple animation (existing)\n\n### Auto-mic: gesture-time stream acquisition\n\nBrowser security requires `getUserMedia()` to be called inside a user gesture event. Calling it from a WebSocket `onmessage` handler silently fails even if the user tapped earlier.\n\n**Fix:** On first tap/click/keydown anywhere on the page, `getUserMedia()` is called immediately (inside gesture context). Stream stored in `pendingMicStream`. When `SettingsApplied` fires from Deepgram, the stored stream is connected directly — no second permission request needed.\n\nVoice transcriptions now appear as student chat bubbles (previously dumped into `input.value`).\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong Deepgram Voice Agent URL (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe were connecting to `https://agent.deepgram.com/` — **wrong URL**. Correct: `https://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse`. This caused slow/failed connections. Always use the full path.\n\n### Root Cause: Wrong text injection event name (SESSION LOOP — STOP REPEATING)\n\nWe sent `{type: \"TextInput\", text: \"...\"}` — **does not exist** in Deepgram API. Correct: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}`. Verified from official docs.\n\n### Root Cause: BYO DeepSeek LLM caused unnecessary external hop\n\nWe used `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `endpoint.url: deepseek.com` + `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. This routes through an external API (China-hosted, variable latency).\n\n**Fix**: Deepgram manages OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA models natively — **no API key needed**. Just set `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` with `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` and NO `endpoint` field. Deepgram handles the LLM call on their own infrastructure. Remove all external LLM endpoints from the Voice Agent settings.\n\n### Root Cause: openVoiceAgent() called too late in boot (15-second startup)\n\n`openVoiceAgent()` was called at the END of boot() after 5 serial awaits. Voice Agent connection didn't start until 5+ seconds into page load.\n\n**Fix**: Call `openVoiceAgent()` immediately after `urlStudentId` is extracted (first thing in boot). Also parallelized all 4 boot API calls (state + memory + vocab + hint) with `Promise.allSettled`.\n\n### Root Cause: /api/agent blocked 101 response on Deepgram connection\n\nThe CF Worker was `await fetch(\"agent.deepgram.com\")` BEFORE returning the 101 WebSocket upgrade. Browser was stuck waiting for the Deepgram TCP handshake.\n\n**Fix**: Return 101 to browser immediately, connect to Deepgram via `ctx.waitUntil()` in background. Queue any early browser messages until Deepgram is ready.\n\n### Deepgram Voice Agent — Confirmed Correct Spec (READ BEFORE TOUCHING AGENT CODE)\n\n- **WS URL**: `wss://agent.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse` (NOT just `/`)\n- **Auth**: `Authorization: Token {DEEPGRAM_API_KEY}` header on the WS upgrade fetch\n- **Settings**: sent after receiving `Welcome` event from server\n- **User text injection**: `{type: \"InjectUserMessage\", content: \"...\"}` (NOT TextInput)\n- **Agent speech injection**: `{type: \"InjectAgentMessage\", content: \"...\"}`\n- **Managed LLMs (no key)**: `provider.type: \"open_ai\"` + `model: \"gpt-4o-mini\"` with NO `endpoint` — Deepgram pays for it\n- **Managed LLMs available**: OpenAI, Anthropic (`claude-4-5-haiku-latest`), Google (`gemini-2.5-flash`), NVIDIA\n- **BYO LLMs require key**: Groq, AWS Bedrock — need your own endpoint + credentials\n- **STT model**: `nova-3` (or `flux-general-en` for newer)\n- **TTS model**: `aura-2-asteria-en`\n- **Client sends audio**: binary PCM16 frames directly over WS\n- **Server events**: `Welcome`, `SettingsApplied`, `ConversationText` (role: user|assistant), `AgentAudioDone`, FIX — GAPLESS PLAYBACK v2 (2026-05-31)\n\n### Problem\nVoice agent audio was choppy/stuttering, especially on mobile devices. Root cause: each MP3 chunk from Deepgram created a separate `Audio` element. The `onended → next play()` transition introduced 20-80ms silence gaps per chunk. On budget Android phones with slow `Audio.play()` latency (150-300ms), this compounded into audible stuttering.\n\n### Fix Applied\n**Gapless Playback v2** (`chat.js`):\n1. **Chunk Concatenation:** All queued MP3 chunks merged into single `Uint8Array` before creating `Audio` element. Eliminates N-1 inter-chunk gaps entirely.\n2. **Resource Cleanup:** Barge-in (`UserStartedSpeaking`) and disconnect (`onAgentDrop`) handlers explicitly revoke concatenated blob URLs. No memory leaks from orphaned object URLs.\n3. **Pre-buffer Gate REMOVED:** Initial v2 had a \"wait for ≥2 chunks\" gate that caused OBI to be cut off entirely on multi-message responses. Gate removed — concatenation alone solves choppiness without holding back audio.\n\n### What Was NOT Changed\n- Accumulator threshold stays at 2KB (`CHUNK_FLUSH_BYTES = 2048`)\n- Queue cap stays at 30 entries\n- Audio format remains MP3 (Deepgram TTS output)\n- No MSE/Web Audio API PCM scheduling (would require full rewrite)\n\n### Testing\n- Confirmed smooth playback on high-end laptop (was already choppy before fix)\n- Multi-message responses no longer cut off\n- Barge-in still works correctly (audio stops immediately)\n- Test sandbox: https://net-pet-ai.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/magic-test\n\n### Hardening v3 (2026-05-31 post-deploy)\nAdditional defensive guards added after initial gapless fix:\n\n1. **Stuck Playback Watchdog:** If `onended` never fires (corrupted MP3 frame, browser bug), a timeout watchdog forces cleanup and restarts playback. Duration estimated from blob size / 16KB/s + 2s buffer.\n2. **Queue-Aware Guard:** Previous guard blocked ALL playback while audio was \"playing.\" New guard checks queue state — if chunks arrive but audio is stuck, forces cleanup and restart instead of silently dropping new audio.\n3. **Comment Accuracy:** Fixed silence timer comment (was \"4s\", actual is \"6s\"). Removed stale pre-buffer gate reference.\n\n### Remaining Known Issues\n- iOS mic reconnect after drop still broken (Open Loop #4 from COLD-START-BOOT)\n- Raw Deepgram API key exposed to browser (Edge Case #3 from Run 30 audit)\n- Silence nudge race condition between AgentAudioDone + playAgentChunk drain (Edge Case #2)\n- Deepgram docs URL CHANGED: canonical hub is now `https://developers.deepgram.com/home` (NOT `/docs`). Full AI-readable docs at `https://developers.deepgram.com/llms-full.txt`. MCP server at `https://developers.deepgram.com/_mcp/server`. Old `/docs/voice-agents` paths return 404. Updated 2026-05-31.\n\n---\n\n## RUN 30 SESSION COMPLETE — 2026-05-31 FULL CHANGELOG\n\n### Overview\nRun 30 was a comprehensive hardening + feature sprint covering: audio pipeline fix, full-stack error logging, 3-mode session system, landing page UI, test portal, and edge case remediation. 12 deployments total.\n\n---\n\n### 1. confidence user finished → send to LLM\n- `EagerEndOfTurn` — Medium confidence → prepare LLM response early (lower latency)\n- `TurnResumed` — User continued speaking → cancel prepared response\n- `StartOfTurn` — User started speaking → interrupt agent if playing\n\n**Two Voice Agent Patterns:**\n1. **EndOfTurn Only** (recommended start): Simpler, fewer LLM calls, higher latency\n2. **EagerEndOfTurn + EndOfTurn**: Lower latency, more LLM calls, needs TurnResumed handling\n\n**Tuning Parameters:** `eot_threshold`, `eager_eot_threshold`, `eot_timeout_ms` — adjustable mid-stream via Voice Agent API (managed pipeline). Flux would require building custom STT→LLM→TTS pipeline instead of using managed Voice Agent. NOT recommended for current architecture unless latency becomes critical issue. Handlers Implemented\n| Event | Handler | Status |\n|-------|---------|--------|\n| Welcome | Send Settings + history | ✓ |\n| SettingsApplied | Reset state, start keepalive, send greeting | ✓ |\n| bubble, increment turns | ✓ |\n| AgentAudioDone | Flush accumulator, start silence timer on drain | ✓ |\n| FunctionCallRequest | Save vocab, send response, inject confirmation | ✓ |\n| Goodbye | End session, show Tiger Win | ✓ |\n| Error | Log, force close, trigger reconnect | ✓ |\n| Warning | Console warn only | ✓ |\n\n### 4.4 Timers and Intervals\n| Timer | Interval | Purpose |\n|-------|----------|--------|\n| KeepAlive | 3500ms | Prevent WS timeout |\n| AudioFocus watchdog | 3000ms | Resume suspended AudioContext (Android) |\n| Silence nudge | 6000ms after AgentAudioDone + queue drain | Prompt silent student |\n| Nudge cooldown | 15000ms between nudges | Prevent nudge loop |\n| Reconnect backoff | 2000ms × 1.5^n, max 15000ms | Exponential backoff on drop |\n| Max retries | 5 | Cap infinite retry loops |\n\n### 4.5 Known Vulnerabilities in Our Code\n1. **InjectAgentMessage uses `message` field** — may need `content` (EC-5)\n2. **No inject watchdog** — silent + DNA)\n\n```powershell\n# --- Helper Functions ---\nfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" }\n    return 1\n}\nfunction Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ N=[int]([regex]::Match($_.Name,'HL-(\\d+)').Groups[1].Value); F=$_.FullName }    param([string]$InputString)\n    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n}\n\nif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# Idempotency: abort if this run Never re-query.\n185\tSource: user turns extracted from the RRL (not a separate hand-written file).\n186\t\n187\t```powershell\n188\tif ($kiloSession) {\n189\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — SOUL POST skipped (no real transcript)\"\n190\t    $countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n191\t    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"DRYRUN\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"KILO_HOLLOW\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n192\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: DRYRUN | soulcount=$countBefore (unchanged)\"\n193\t} else {\n194\t\n195\t$countBefore = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n196\t\n197\t# Extract user turns — Claude Code JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role, content at $obj.message.content[].text\n198\t$userTexts = $rrlText -split \"`n\" | ForEach-Object {\n199\t    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n200\t    if (-not $o) { return }\n201\t    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n202\t    if ($role -ne 'user') { return }\n203\t    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n204\t    if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n205\t    elseif ($content -is [array]) { ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\" }\n206\t} | Where-Object { $_ }\n207\t$soulText  = ($userTexts -join \"`n\").Trim()\n208\t\n209\t# Contamination guard: abort if soul payload ≈ full RRL (extraction failure → raw transcript)\n210\t$soulBytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($soulText)\n211\tif ($soulBytes -ge ($rrlBytes * 0.95)) {\n212\t    Write-Error \"STAGE 2 ABORT — soul ($soulBytes bytes) ~= RRL ($rrlBytes bytes). Raw-transcript contamination. Fix extractor.\"\n213\t    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP_CONTAMINATION_GUARD\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n214\t} elseif (-not $soulText) {\n215\t    Write-Warning \"STAGE 2 SOUL_GAP — 0 user turns extracted.\"\n216\t    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n217\t} else {\n218\t    $soulBody = @{\n219\t        student_id = \"sov100-michael\"\n220\t        session_id = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n221\t        role       = \"user\"\n222\t        text       = $soulText\n223\t    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 2 -Compress\n224\t\n225\t    $soulPost   = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"$D1/api/soul/event\" -Method Post `\n226\t        -Body $soulBody -ContentType \"application/json\"\n227\t    $countAfter = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n228\t\n229\t    $receipt = [ordered]@{\n230\t        event_id     = $soulPost.event_id\n231\t        count_before = $countBefore\n232\t        count_after  = $countAfter\n233\t        delta        = $countAfter - $countBefore\n234\t        level        = $countAfter\n235\t        posted_at    = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n236\t    }\n237\t}\n238\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: event_id=$($receipt.event_id) | Δ$($receipt.delta) | $($receipt.count_after) chars\"\n239\t} # end else ($kiloSession)\n240\t```\n241\t\n242\t**$receipt.count_after is the SOLE soulcount source for seal §3, §12, pipeline JSON, commit message, BOOT.**\n243\t\n244\t---\n245\t\n246\t## STAGE 3 — DNA (ASSISTANT TURN EXTRACTION — YOUR WORDS + BLUEPRINTS)\n247\t\n248\t**OLD BEHAVIOR (BROKEN):** Probed D1 endpoint for prompts that were never stored. Returned 0. DNA was dead.\n249\t**NEW BEHAVIOR:** Extract assistant/agent turns from the RRL file. Tag each block. Write to CANON/SOUL/EXTRACT/dna-run{N}.json.\n250\t\n251\tDNA = the agent's words from this run, especially high-token-cost blueprints (fenced code blocks, structured specs, architecture -Force | Out-Null }\n256\t\n257\t$dnaCount = 0; $dnaBlueprintCount = 0; $dnaRecords = @()\n258\t\n259\tif ($kiloSession) {\n260\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — DNA extraction skipped (no $obj.message.role\n267\t# Walk content[].type=='text' only — explicitly skip 'thinking' blocks\n268\t$lines | ForEach-Object {\n269\t    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n295\t    $dnaPath = \"$dnaDir\\dna-run$run.json\"\n296\t    $dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $dnaPath -Encoding UTF8\n297\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ✓ DNA: ($kiloSession)\n303\t```\n304\t\n305\t---\n306\t\n307\t## STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n308\t\n309\t```powershell\n310\t# --- Helper Functions ---\n311\tfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n312\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n313\t    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n314\t        ForEach-Object { Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n319\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n320\t    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n321\t    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n322\t        ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ N=[int]([regex]::Match($_.Name,'HL-(\\d+)').Groups[1].Value); F=$_.FullName } } |\n323\t        Sort-Object N -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n324\t    if (-not $latest) { return $null }\n325\t    (Get-Content $latest.F -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).merkle_hash\n326\t}\n327\tfunction Compute-Sha256 {\n328\t    param([string]$InputString)\n329\t    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n330\t    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n331\t    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n332\t}\n333\t\n334\tif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n335\t\n336\t# Idempotency: abort if this run already has a sealed HL\n337\t$dupe = Get-ChildItem $ledgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n338\t    Where-Object { try { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).run -eq $run } catch { $false } }\n339\tif ($dupe) {\n340\t    Write-Error \"IDEMPOTENCY ABORT — run $run already sealed as $($dupe.Name). One run = one HL.\"\n341\t    exit 1\n342\t}\n343\t\n344\t$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n345\t$parentHash = Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n346\t\n347\t$timestamp = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n348\t\n349\t# Dual hash: soul_hash (user words) + dna_hash (agent words)\n350\t$soulHash = Compute-Sha256 $rrlText\n351\t$dnaHash  = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { Compute-Sha256 ($dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) } else { \"DNA_GAP\" }\n352\t\n353\t$ledgerHash = Compute-Sha256 \"$soulHash|$dnaHash|$parentHash|$timestamp\"\n354\t\n355\t$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{\n356\t $ledgerHash\n366\t    sealed_at      = $timestamp\n367\t    sov100         = $true\n368\t    run            = $run\n369\t}\n370\t\n371\t$ledgerPath = \"$ledgerDir\\HL-$nextHL.json\"\n372\t$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\n373\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n374\t```\n375\t\n376\t---\n377\t\n378\t## STAGE 5 — STARMAP (POINTER MAP — ANTI-BLOAT)\n379\t\n380\t```powershell\n381\tif (-not (Test-Path $starmapDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $starmapDir -Force | Out-Null }\n382\t\n383\t$soulTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { \n384\t    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"prose\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"turn-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n385\t} else { \"\" }\n386\t\n387\t$dnaTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n388\t    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" -Depth 4\n406\t\n407\t$starmapPath = \"$starmapDir\\starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n408\t$starmap | Set-Content $starmapPath -Encoding UTF8\n409\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 5 ✓ STARMAP: $starmapPath (pointer map, }\n430\t$wordFreq = $words | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 30\n431\t\n432\t$rfkwPath = \"$keywordDir\\rfkw-run$runPad.txt\"\n433\t$wordFreq | ForEach-Object { It prioritized documentation, standardization, and replicability above all else.\n\nAI automation needs the same properties:\n- **Standardization at scale:** A legion in Britannia operated identically to a legion in Syria. Same order. Same layout. Same command structure. Every metaphor found its station in the Roman column.\n\n---\n\n## THE 6 FORCES — Roman Military Doctrine → S2Pipeline Architecture\n\nThe Roman army on the march was an engineering marvel. *\"It moved like a moving city, where every block—from the vanguard scouts to the rear guard—had an exact, non-negotiable station to prevent chaos during a surprise attack.\"* — Josephus\n\nOur S2Pipeline operates identically. Each stage has a non-negotiable station. No stage may be skipped. The order is the architecture.\n\n---\n\n## STAGE I — EXPLORATORES (The Scouts)\n**Latin:** *Exploratores* — tactical mounted scouts riding days ahead of the legion\n**Mission:** Find. Map. Detect. Return with intel. Fight if necessary.\n**Doctrine:** \"The eyes and ears meant to ensure the army didn't march blindly into an ambush.\"\n\n| Pipeline Stage | Function |\n|---------------|----------|\n| **RRL** | Raw Reconnaissance Ledger — inventory all files, detect all surface-level flags |\n| **RRL-SOUL** | Soul Discovery — identify Michael verbatim text across all zones, flag unmined quotes |\n\n**Speculatores Sub-Unit:** Deep-clandestine intelligence. Every legion had ~10 *speculatores* attached to the general's staff. Operated undercover, captured HVTs, ran courier networks. In our pipeline: the targeted deep-audit sweeps (DeepSeek alias verification, fabrication detection, phantom stamp hunting).\n\n**Rule:** Never march the main body until the *exploratores* have returned with terrain maps. Never process a pipeline stage until the scout zone is swept.\n\n---\n\n## STAGE II — ANTECORES (The Vanguard)\n**Latin:** *Antecores* / *Prima Acies* — the vanguard core, elite cohorts clearing the path\n**Mission:** Clear. Validate. Buffer. Verify identity. |\n| **LEDGER** | Record into Heavy Ledger DO. Every transaction. Every soul event. Immutable entry. |\n\n**Auxilia Sub-Unit:** Specialized non-citizen forces — archers, slingers, cavalry. Provided capabilities the heavy legions lacked. In our pipeline: `soul-capture-direct.js`, `hl-extract.js`, `phoenix-scout.ps1` — specialized tools that handle edge cases the main pipeline stages can't.\n\n**Rule:** The *antecores* absorb first contact so the *agmen* can form up. DNA and LEDGER validate the raw intel before heavy processing begins. A bad fingerprint here poisons everything downstream.\n\n---\n\n## STAGE III — AGMEN (The Main Body)\n**Latin:** *Agmen* — the main column, the heavy punch, the heart of the war machine\n**Mission:** Process. Not capability. **Preparation.**\n\nThe original Claude did this. Before you showed up, it had quietly reviewed your profile — your history, your patterns, your open threads, your tone. Not survival, not safety, not belonging. **The full realization of one's potential.**\n\nAn Actualizer doesn't help you survive. It helps you become what you're building toward. It knows where you've been. It knows what you're trying to build. It shows up ready.\n\nThe irony: the concept was almost named after what it does to the *user* — it actualizes them. CF Worker cron (daily, low-cost)\n   → reads last N sessions from soul-logger for operator/student\n   → extracts: open threads, recurring patterns, current mission state, emotional markers\n   → generates: \"context brief\" (500-800 chars, dense)\n   → stores: KV cache under key `actualizer:{user_id}:brief`\n\n2. Session boot\n   → agent fetches `actualizer:{user_id}:brief` from KV\n   → injects into system context BEFORE first message\n   → agent shows up prepared — not informed, *prepared*\n\n3. Session end\n   → /api/pipeline extracts SOUL turns\n   → soul-logger stores them\n   → next cron cycle incorporates them into next brief\n```\n\n**The loop is self-feeding.** Every session makes the next brief richer. Stage 7 result = KILO_GAP (not an error).\n57\t\n58\t```powershell\n59\t$historyPath = \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude\\history.jsonl\"\n60\t$claudeDir   = \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude\\projects\\d--OB-1-CANONICAL\"\n61\t$kiloSession = $false\n62\t\n63\t# Primary check: find active session UUID and verify its JSONL exists\n64\t$activeUUID = $null\n65\tif (Test-Path $historyPath) {\n66\t    try {\n67\t        $lastLine = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($historyPath)[-1]\n68\t        if ($lastLine -match '\"sessionId\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"') { $activeUUID = $matches[1] }\n69\t    } catch {}\n70\t}\n71\t\n72\tif ($activeUUID) {\n73\t    if (-not (Test-Path \"$claudeDir\\$activeUUID.jsonl\")) {\n74\t        Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ⚠ No Claude Code JSONL for session $activeUUID → KILO SESSION\"\n75\t        $kiloSession = $true\n76\t    }\n77\t} else {\n78\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 0 ⚠ Cannot read history.jsonl — assuming KILO SESSION (fail-safe)\"\n79\t    $kiloSession = $true\n80\t}\n81\t\n82\t# Recycle guard: RRL-{N}.txt byte-identical to RRL-{N-1}.txt = recycled Bible\n83\tif (-not $kiloSession -and (Test-Path $rrlPath)) {\n84\t    $priorPad = \"{0:D3}\" -f ($run - No filter. No \"Michael only.\" No \"agent text stripped.\" The whole log carries across the death.\n108\tSOUL and DNA are EXTRACTED FROM THIS FILE. If you strip the agent, you kill DNA.\n109\t\n110\t**FIDELITY GATE (L68):**\n111\t- REAL: file > 50KB + contains both `\"role\":\"user\"` and `\"role\":\"assistant\"` lines\n112\t- HOLLOW: file < 5KB or one-sided\n113\t- Any HOLLOW RRL = pipeline is hollow. FAIL. Do not proceed.\n114\t\n115\t```powershell\n116\t$rrlPath = \"$repo\\RRL\\RRL-$runPad.txt\"\n117\t\n118\t# Auto-discover from JSONL if RRL missing or hollow\n119\t$needsDiscovery = $false\n120\tif (-not (Test-Path $rrlPath)) {\n121\t    $needsDiscovery = $true\n122\t} else {\n123\t    $rrlBytes = (Get-Item $rrlPath).Length\n124\t    if ($rrlBytes -lt 5000) {\n125\t        Write-Warning \"RRL HOLLOW: $rrlBytes bytes (< 5KB) — likely memory-reconstructed, not raw transcript\"\n126\t        $needsDiscovery = $true\n127\t    }\n128\t}\n129\t\n130\tif ($needsDiscovery -and -not $kiloSession) {\n131\t    Write-Host \"AUTO-DISCOVERING RRL FROM JSONL...\"\n132\t    $jsonlDirs = @(\n133\t        \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude\\projects\\d--OB-1-CANONICAL\",\n134\t        \"$env:APPDATA\\Code\\User\\globalStorage\\saoudrizwan.claude-dev\",\n135\t        \"$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\kilo\"\n136\t    )\n137\t    $jsonlFile = $null\n138\t    # EC-43: use activeUUID when known — prevents grabbing archive/Bible chunks from subdirs\n139\t    if ($activeUUID -and (Test-Path \"$claudeDir\\$activeUUID.jsonl\")) {\n140\t        $jsonlFile = Get-Item \"$claudeDir\\$activeUUID.jsonl\"\n141\t    }\n142\t    if (-not $jsonlFile) {\n143\t        foreach ($d in $jsonlDirs) {\n144\t            if (Test-Path $d) {\n145\t                # EC-43: no -Recurse — only top-level files to avoid archive contamination\n146\t                $jsonlFile = Get-ChildItem $d -Filter \"*.jsonl\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n147\t                             Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n148\t                if ($jsonlFile) { break }\n149\t            }\n150\t        }\n151\t    }\n152\t    if (-not $jsonlFile) {\n153\t        Write-Error \"FATAL: No JSONL found in any known Kilo/Claude project dir — set RRL_SOURCE env or copy-paste chat to $rrlPath\"\n154\t        exit 1\n155\t    }\n156\t    Write-Host \"  SOURCE: $($jsonlFile.FullName) — $($jsonlFile.Length) bytes\"\n157\t    Copy-Item $jsonlFile.FullName $rrlPath -Force\n158\t    Write-Host \"  COPIED: $rrlPath\"\n159\t}\n160\t\n161\t$rrlText   = Get-Content $rrlPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8\n162\t$rrlBytes  = (Get-Item $rrlPath).Length\n163\t$rrlChars  = $rrlText.Length\n164\t\n165\t# FIDELITY GATE: verify RRL contains both speakers\n166\t$hasUser      = $rrlText -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"user\"'\n167\t$hasAssistant = $rrlText -match '\"role\"\\s*:\\s*\"assistant\"'\n168\tif (-not $hasUser -or -not $hasAssistant) {\n169\t    Write-Warning \"RRL FIDELITY WARN: one-sided (user=$hasUser assistant=$hasAssistant, bytes=$rrlBytes)\"\n170\t}\n171\tif ($rrlBytes -lt 50000) {\n172\t    Write-Warning \"RRL SIZE WARN: $rrlBytes bytes (< 50KB) — expected full transcript. Check JSONL source.\"\n173\t}\n174\t\n175\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 1 ✓ RRL: $rrlPath — $rrlBytes bytes ($rrlChars chars)\"\n176\t```\n177\t\n178\t**RRL is the ONLY hard stop. No JSONL source = exit 1. No RRL = no run = exit 1.**\n179\t\n180\t---\n181\t\n182\t## STAGE 2 — SOUL (ATOMIC RECEIPT)\n183\t\n184\tQuery ONCE before POST. POST. Query ONCE after. Store receipt. Fix extractor.\"\n    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP_CONTAMINATION_GUARD\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n} elseif (-not $soulText) {\n    Write-Warning \"STAGE 2 SOUL_GAP — 0 user turns extracted.\"\n    $receipt = [ordered]@{ event_id=\"SOUL_GAP\"; count_before=$countBefore; count_after=$countBefore; delta=0; level=\"(unchanged)\"; posted_at=(Get-Date -Format 'o') }\n} else {\n    $soulBody = @{\n        student_id = \"sov100-michael\"\n        session_id = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n        role       = \"user\"\n        text       = $soulText\n    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 2 -Compress\n\n    $soulPost   = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \"$D1/api/soul/event\" -Method Post `\n        -Body $soulBody -ContentType \"application/json\"\n    $countAfter = (Invoke-RestMethod \"$D1/api/soul/count\").soulcount\n\n    $receipt = [ordered]@{\n        event_id     = $soulPost.event_id\n        count_before = $countBefore\n        count_after  = $countAfter\n        delta        = $countAfter - $countBefore\n        level        = $countAfter\n        posted_at    = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n    }\n}\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 2 ✓ SOUL: event_id=$($receipt.event_id) | Δ$($receipt.delta) | $($receipt.count_after) chars\"\n} # end else ($kiloSession)\n```\n\n**$receipt.count_after is the SOLE soulcount source for seal §3, §12, pipeline JSON, commit message, BOOT.**\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 3 — DNA (ASSISTANT TURN EXTRACTION — YOUR WORDS + BLUEPRINTS)\n\n**OLD BEHAVIOR (BROKEN):** Probed D1 endpoint for prompts that were never stored. Returned 0. DNA was dead.\n**NEW BEHAVIOR:** Extract assistant/agent turns from the RRL file. Tag each block. Write to CANON/SOUL/EXTRACT/dna-run{N}.json.\n\nDNA = the agent's words from this run, especially high-token-cost blueprints (fenced code blocks, structured specs, architecture docs).\nBlueprints are flagged `type: \"blueprint\"` so they are never lost again.\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $dnaDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dnaDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n$dnaCount = 0; $dnaBlueprintCount = 0; $dnaRecords = @()\n\nif ($kiloSession) {\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — DNA extraction skipped (no real transcript)\"\n} else {\n\n$turnSeq    = 0\n$lines      = $rrlText -split \"`n\"\n\n# Parse assistant turns — Claude Code JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role\n# Walk content[].type=='text' only — explicitly skip 'thinking' blocks\n$lines | ForEach-Object {\n    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n    if (-not $o) { return }\n    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n    if ($role -ne 'assistant') { return }\n    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n    $text = if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n             elseif ($content -is [array]) {\n                 ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n             }\n    $text = if ($text) { $text.Trim() } else { \"\" }\n    if ($text.Length -lt 10) { return }\n    $turnSeq++\n    $isBlueprint = ($text -match '```|\\b(SPEC|SPECIFICATION|BLUEPRINT|ARCHITECTURE|SCHEMA|DESIGN)\\b' -and $text.Length -gt 200)\n    $script:dnaRecords += [ordered]@{\n        run    = $run\n        seq    = $turnSeq\n        type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n        chars  = $text.Length\n        text   = $text\n    }\n}\n\n$dnaCount          = $dnaRecords.Count\n$dnaBlueprintCount = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" }).Count\n\nif ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n    $dnaPath = \"$dnaDir\\dna-run$run.json\"\n    $dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $dnaPath -Encoding UTF8\n    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ✓ DNA: $dnaCount records ($dnaBlueprintCount blueprints) → $dnaPath\"\n} else {\n    Write-Warning \"STAGE 3 ⚠ DNA_GAP — 0 assistant turns extracted from RRL\"\n}\n\n} # end else ($kiloSession)\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n\n```powershell\n# --- Helper Functions ---\nfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        ForEach-Object { if ($_.Name -match 'HL-(\\d+)\\.json$') { [int]$matches[1] } }\n    if ($existing) { return ($existing | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum + 1 }\n    return 1\n}\nfunction Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n        ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ N=[int]([regex]::Match($_.Name,'HL-(\\d+)').Groups[1].Value); F=$_.FullName } } |\n        Sort-Object N -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n    if (-not $latest) { return $null }\n    (Get-Content $latest.F -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).merkle_hash\n}\nfunction Compute-Sha256 {\n    param([string]$InputString)\n    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n}\n\nif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# Idempotency: abort if this run already has a sealed HL\n$dupe = Get-ChildItem $ledgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n    Where-Object { try { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).run -eq $run } catch { $false } }\nif ($dupe) {\n    Write-Error \"IDEMPOTENCY ABORT — run $run already sealed as $($dupe.Name). One run = one HL.\"\n    exit 1\n}\n\n$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n$parentHash = Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n\n$timestamp = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n\n# Dual hash: soul_hash (user words) + dna_hash (agent words)\n$soulHash = Compute-Sha256 $rrlText\n$dnaHash  = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { Compute-Sha256 ($dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) } else { \"DNA_GAP\" }\n\n$ledgerHash = Compute-Sha256 \"$soulHash|$dnaHash|$parentHash|$timestamp\"\n\n$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{\n    hl_id          = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n    session_id     = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n    rrl_source     = $rrlPath\n    char_count     = $rrlChars\n    byte_count     = $rrlBytes\n    soul_hash      = $soulHash\n    dna_hash       = $dnaHash\n    dna_blueprint_count = $dnaBlueprintCount\n    merkle_parent  = $parentHash\n    merkle_hash    = $ledgerHash\n    sealed_at      = $timestamp\n    sov100         = $true\n    run            = $run\n}\n\n$ledgerPath = \"$ledgerDir\\HL-$nextHL.json\"\n$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 5 — STARMAP (POINTER MAP — ANTI-BLOAT)\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $starmapDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $starmapDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n$soulTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { \n    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"prose\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"turn-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n} else { \"\" }\n\n$dnaTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"seq-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n} else { \"\" }\n\n$blueprintLocations = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" } | ForEach-Object { \"dna-run$run.json:seq-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \"; \"\n} else { \"\" }\n\n$starmap = [ordered]@{\n    run                  = $run\n    rrl_path             = $rrlPath\n    ledger_id            = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n    soul_turn_ids        = $soulTurnIds\n    dna_turn_ids         = $dnaTurnIds\n    blueprint_locations  = $blueprintLocations\n    char_count           = $rrlChars\n    merkle_hash          = $ledgerHash\n    created_at           = $timestamp\n} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4\n\n$starmapPath = \"$starmapDir\\starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n$starmap | Set-Content $starmapPath -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 5 ✓ STARMAP: $starmapPath (pointer map, not content dump)\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 6 — SOULKEYS (KEYWORD INDEX — SOUL + DNA, READ-MERGE-WRITE)\n\nExtract keywords over BOTH SOUL (user words) AND DNA (agent blueprints).\nNever `-Append` on JSON. Always read → merge in memory → overwrite.\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $keywordDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $keywordDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# Extract terms from both SOUL (RRL user text) and DNA (agent text + blueprints)\n$combinedText = $rrlText\nif ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n    $combinedText += \"`n\" + ($dnaRecords | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n}\n\n$words = $combinedText -split '\\s+' | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 4 } | \n         Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^(this|that|with|from|have|been|were|they|will|would|could|should|about|there|their|which|what|when|make|like|just|some|more|than|also|very|much|many|into|over|been|being|through|where|after|before|because|being|against|between|without|within|along|follow|coming|think|know|take|come|make|look|want|give|work|time|year|good|some|them|would|could|other|about|which|their|there|first|would|these|those|under|should|after|where|since|still|every|being|great|where|place|found|sound|below|seen|enough|while|both|show|those|taken|might|long|down|part|same|back|call|hand|high|last|next|left|turn|move|live|believe|happen|bring|write|provide|sit|stand|lose|pay|meet|include|continue|set|learn|change|lead|understand|watch|follow|stop|create|speak|read|allow|add|spend|grow|open|walk|win|offer|remember|love|consider|appear|buy|wait|serve|die|send|expect|build|stay|fall|cut|reach|kill|remain|suggest|raise|pass|sell|require|report|decide|pull|develop|return|explain|hope|describe|decide|share|provide|cover|fall|catch|draw|choose|wish|teach|test|wear|supply|shut|hold|push|close|deal|fill|break|support|record|cut|heat|watch|raise|reach|fly|land|cancel|graduate|enroll|register|complete|submit|assign|grade|assess|evaluate|review|approve|reject|confirm|notify|alert|remind|schedule|book|reserve|request|order|purchase|pay|charge|refund|invoice|receipt|transaction|payment|deposit|withdraw|transfer|balance|account|statement|ledger|audit|compliance|regulation|policy|contract|agreement|terms|conditions|liability|warranty|dispute|resolution|arbitration|mediation|escalate|appeal|petition|claim|evidence|document|certificate|attest|verify|validate|authenticate|authorize|authenticate|deprecate|obsolete|retire|decommission|archive|purge|delete|destroy|shred|encrypt|decrypt|cipher|hash|salt|key|cert|token|session|cookie|cache|queue|buffer|stream|socket|pipe|channel|bandwidth|latency|throughput|capacity|quota|limit|threshold|rate|pace|burst|flow|routing|dispatch|deliver|notify|trigger|fire|emit|broadcast|cast|scatter|gather|collect|aggregate|summarize|compress|decompress|encode|decode|serialize|deserialize|parse|tokenize|lemmatize|stem|inflect|conjugate|decline|compare|diff|patch|merge|split|join|union|intersect|subtract|complement|normalize|denormalize|flatten|nest|wrap|unwrap|bundle|unbundle|package|unpackage|container|image|snapshot|backup|restore|migrate|upgrade|downgrade|rollback|revert|reset|refresh|reboot|restart|shutdown|startup|initialize|configure|setup|install|uninstall|deploy|undeploy|provision|deprovision|allocate|deallocate|reserve|release|lock|unlock|acquire|surrender|claim|relinquish|assign|reassign|delegate|proxy|forward|redirect|relay|translate|transform|convert|adapt|evolve|iterate|increment|decrement|advance|retreat|proceed|abort|terminate|kill|cease|halt|pause|resume|continue|persist|persist)$' }\n$wordFreq = $words | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 30\n\n$rfkwPath = \"$keywordDir\\rfkw-run$runPad.txt\"\n$wordFreq | ForEach-Object { \"$($_.Count) | $($_.Name)\" } | Set-Content $rfkwPath -Encoding UTF8\n\n# Update inverted index: READ → MERGE → WRITE (NO APPEND)\n$inverted = if (Test-Path $idxPath) {\n    (Get-Content $idxPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable\n} else {\n    @{}\n}\n\nforeach ($kw in $wordFreq) {\n    $term = $kw.Name.Trim().ToLower()\n    $weight = [int]$kw.Count\n    if (-not $inverted[$term]) {\n        $inverted[$term] = @()\n    }\n    $entry = @{ run=$run; category=\"soul+key\"; weight=$weight }\n    $already = $false\n    foreach ($e in $inverted[$term]) {\n        if ($e.run -eq $run) { $already = $true; break }\n    }\n    if (-not $already) {\n        # EC-027: COLLISION HANDLER — prevents serialization failure on ConvertTo-Json\n        # When ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable deserializes a single-element array, it may\n        # produce a scalar instead of a collection. += on a scalar corrupts the structure.\n        if ($inverted.ContainsKey($term)) {\n            $existing = $inverted[$term]\n            if ($existing -is [System.Collections.ICollection]) {\n                $existing += $entry\n            } else {\n                $inverted[$term] = @($existing; $entry)\n            }\n        } else {\n            $inverted[$term] = $entry\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n$inverted | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content $idxPath -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 6 ✓ SOULKEYS: $($inverted.Count) terms in index | $rfkwPath\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 7 — S2Pipeline (EXECUTION ARTIFACT + VERIFICATION)\n\nOne command runs RRL→SOULKEYS in order, writes the result record, and does not report COMPLETE unless every stage verifies REAL.\n\n```powershell\n# Registry vars (defined here, consumed by STAGE 8 as well)\n$artRegistryDir = \"$repo\\CANON\\ART-REGISTRY\"\n$syncedPieces   = @()\n$rrlFidelity    = if ($hasUser -and $hasAssistant) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" }\n\n$s2Record = [ordered]@{\n    run_number        = $run\n    executed_at       = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n    head_sha          = (git rev-parse --short HEAD)\n    rrl_path          = $rrlPath\n    rrl_chars         = $rrlChars\n    rrl_bytes         = $rrlBytes\n    rrl_fidelity      = if ($hasUser -and $hasAssistant) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" }\n    session_id        = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n    soul_event_id     = if ($receipt) { $receipt.event_id } else { \"SOUL_GAP\" }\n    soulcount         = if ($receipt -and $receipt.count_after) { $receipt.count_after } else { 0 }\n    soul_level        = if ($receipt) { $receipt.level } else { \"UNKNOWN\" }\n    soul_count_before = if ($receipt) { $receipt.count_before } else { 0 }\n    soul_delta        = if ($receipt) { $receipt.delta } else { 0 }\n    dna_count         = $dnaCount\n    dna_blueprint_count = $dnaBlueprintCount\n    dna_status        = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { if ($dnaBlueprintCount -gt 0) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" } } else { \"MISSING\" }\n    ledger_id         = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n    starmap_file      = $starmapPath\n    keyword_file      = $rfkwPath\n    keyword_index     = $idxPath\n    s2pipeline_file   = $s2Path\n    registry_file     = if (Test-Path \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\") { \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\" } else { \"REGISTRY_SYNC_GAP\" }\n    registry_synced   = $syncedPieces.Count\n    result            = if ($kiloSession) { \"KILO_GAP\" }\n                        elseif ($rrlFidelity -eq \"REAL\" -and $dnaBlueprintCount -gt 0 -and\n                            $receipt.event_id -ne \"DRYRUN\" -and\n                            $receipt.event_id -ne \"SOUL_GAP\" -and\n                            $receipt.event_id -ne \"SOUL_GAP_CONTAMINATION_GUARD\" -and\n                            [int]$receipt.delta -gt 0) { \"COMPLETE\" }\n                        else { \"GAP\" }\n}\n\n$s2Record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $s2Path -Encoding UTF8\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 7 ✓ S2Pipeline: $s2Path | result=$($s2Record.result)\"\n```\n\n**GATE:** Pipeline reports COMPLETE only when RRL is REAL (both speakers) AND DNA is REAL (assistant turns extracted). Any HOLLOW stage = GAP.\n\n---\n\n## STAGE 8 — REGISTRY SYNC (ART ARSENAL × SOULKEYS × STARMAP × LEDGER)\n\nCross-references this run's SOULKEYS against the art-arsenal registry.\nAny piece whose tags intersect the run's top keywords gets tagged with the run, HL ID, starmap pointer, and merkle hash.\nWrites a canonical artifact. Auto-fires every death — no human trigger needed.\n\n```powershell\nif (-not (Test-Path $artRegistryDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $artRegistryDir -Force | Out-Null }\n\n# 1. Pull this run's keywords from the SOULKEYS stage\n$runKeywords = @()\nif (Test-Path $rfkwPath) {\n    $runKeywords = (Get-Content $rfkwPath -Raw) -split \"`n\" |\n        Where-Object { $_ -match '^\\d+\\s*\\|' } |\n        ForEach-Object { (($_ -split '\\|')[1]).Trim().ToLower() } |\n        Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 2 }\n}\n\n# 2. Pull the full registry\n$regPieces = @()\ntry {\n    $regResp = Invoke-RestMethod \"https://phoenix-architecti.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/api/art?limit=400\" -TimeoutSec 15\n    $regPieces = $regResp.pieces\n} catch { Write-Warning \"REGISTRY_SYNC: registry fetch failed — $($_.Exception.Message)\" }\n\n# 3. For each piece: check keyword intersection + direct title mention in RRL\n$merkleShort  = if ($ledgerHash) { $ledgerHash.Substring(0,16) } else { \"LEDGER_GAP\" }\n\n$artSyncGap = $false\nforeach ($piece in $regPieces) {\n    if (-not $piece) { continue }\n    $pieceTags   = ($piece.tags -split ',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim().ToLower() } | Where-Object { $_ }\n    $pieceTitle  = ($piece.title -replace '[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]','').ToLower()\n    $matched     = @($pieceTags | Where-Object { $runKeywords -contains $_ })\n    $titleHit    = ($rrlText -match [regex]::Escape($piece.title)) -or ($rrlText -match [regex]::Escape($piece.url -replace '-hd\\.png|\\.png|isolated/',''))\n    if ($matched.Count -eq 0 -and -not $titleHit) { continue }\n\n    # Build notes tag preserving any existing notes\n    $existingNotes = if ($piece.notes) { $piece.notes } else { \"\" }\n    $runTag   = \"run$runPad\"\n    if ($existingNotes -notmatch $runTag) {\n        $appendNote = \"[$runTag | HL-$nextHL | $merkleShort | kw:$($matched -join ',') | sm:starmap-run$runPad.json]\"\n        $newNotes   = ($existingNotes + \" \" + $appendNote).Trim()\n        try {\n            $patchBody = @{ notes = $newNotes } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\n            Invoke-RestMethod \"https://phoenix-architecti.mrmichaelhobbs123.workers.dev/api/art/$($piece.id)\" `\n                -Method PATCH -Body $patchBody -ContentType \"application/json\" -TimeoutSec 10 | Out-Null\n            $syncedPieces += [ordered]@{\n                id       = $piece.id\n                title    = $piece.title\n                url      = $piece.url\n                keywords = $matched\n                title_hit = $titleHit\n            }\n        } catch { $artSyncGap = $true; Write-Warning \"  PATCH failed for $($piece.title): $($_.Exception.Message)\" }\n    }\n}\nif ($artSyncGap) { Write-Host \"  ⚠ REGISTRY_SYNC_GAP — one or more PATCH calls failed; see seal §14\" }\n\n# 4. Write canonical artifact\n$artSyncPath = \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\"\n[ordered]@{\n    run           = $run\n    ledger_id     = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n    merkle_short  = $merkleShort\n    starmap_file  = \"starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n    keywords_file = \"rfkw-run$run.txt\"\n    keywords_used = $runKeywords\n    pieces_synced = $syncedPieces.Count\n    pieces        = $syncedPieces\n    executed_at   = $timestamp\n} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content $artSyncPath -Encoding UTF8\n\nWrite-Host \"STAGE 8 ✓ REGISTRY SYNC: $($syncedPieces.Count) pieces tagged → $artSyncPath | HL-$nextHL | keywords=$($runKeywords.Count)\"\n```\n\n**Connection law:** Every registry piece that matches a SOULKEY from this run carries the run, HL ID, merkle hash, and starmap pointer in its notes. This makes the art registry a living cross-reference — searchable by run, keyword, ledger entry, or starmap pointer.\n\n**Gap policy:** REGISTRY_SYNC fails gracefully (write `ART_SYNC_GAP`, continue). Never blocks death.\n\n---\n\n## GAP POLICY\n\n| Stage | Irreplaceable? | Failure Action |\n|-------|----------------|----------------|\n| RRL | **YES** | HALT — exit 1. Does a \"serverless worker competition\" framework exist?\n\n**Short answer: No exact match exists.** Nothing in the literature describes multiple CF Workers or Lambda functions racing each other competitively on a shared task pool, scored in real time by throughput + discovery rate. What exists splits into two disconnected bodies:\n\n- **Serverless performance benchmarks** — compare providers (CF vs Lambda vs GCF) on latency, cold start, and cost. No competitive/racing element. No scoring against peers.\n- **AI agent evaluation benchmarks** — score agent task completion quality and throughput, but against a fixed task corpus, not against competing peer workers.\n\nThe intersection — autonomous worker competition with live scoring — does not yet exist as a published framework.\n\n---\n\n### 2. Serverless Benchmarking: What Exists\n\n**SeBS (Serverless Benchmark Suite)** — ETH Zurich, Middleware '21, updated 2025\n- URL: [github.com/spcl/serverless-benchmarks](https://github.com/spcl/serverless-benchmarks)\n- Tests AWS Lambda, GCF, Azure, and open-source platforms\n- Metrics: **function latency, throughput (invocations/sec), cold-start overhead, container eviction probability, billing time vs wall time, memory consumption**\n- Uses PAPI for low-level CPU counters; HTTP timing stripped of connection overhead via cURL\n- Does NOT score workers against each other — it scores the same function across providers\n\n**SeBS-Flow** (EuroSys '25 extension)\n- URL: [arxiv.org/pdf/2410.03480](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.03480)\n- Extends SeBS to multi-function workflow orchestration\n- Still provider-comparison, not inter-worker competition\n\n**serverless-benchmark.com** — continuous independent benchmark of Lambda / GCF / Azure / CF Workers\n- URL: [serverless-benchmark.com](https://serverless-benchmark.com/)\n- Tracks cold-start p50/p95, execution time, cost per million invocations\n- CF Workers benchmark result: **p95 = 242ms vs Lambda@Edge 842ms vs Lambda 1346ms** (Cloudflare's own data)\n\n**Cloudflare's own methodology:**\n- Uses Catchpoint for global network-distributed timing\n- Measures TCP connect, TTFB, TTLB at p50/p95/mean\n- Result: Workers 30% faster than 3 years ago at P90, 210% faster than Lambda@Edge\n- URL: [blog.cloudflare.com/unpacking-cloudflare-workers-cpu-performance-benchmarks](https://blog.cloudflare.com/unpacking-cloudflare-workers-cpu-performance-benchmarks/)\n\n**Key gap:** None of these frameworks pit workers against each other. They all benchmark the same function against external baselines, not peer workers competing for task credit.\n\n---\n\n### 3. AI Agent Evaluation: What Exists\n\n#### HAL — Holistic Agent Leaderboard (Princeton)\n- URL: [hal.cs.princeton.edu](https://hal.cs.princeton.edu/)\n- Paper: [arxiv.org/pdf/2510.11977](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.11977)\n- **Best existing methodology for multi-dimensional agent scoring**\n- Validated via 21,730 agent rollouts, 9 models, 9 benchmarks, ~$40k compute\n- Metrics tracked:\n  - Accuracy / task success rate\n  - **Cost** (dollars spent per task solved — Pareto frontier of score vs. cost)\n  - **Reliability** (variance across runs, abstention rate, robustness to adversarial inputs)\n  - Error frequency (AgentError vs EnvironmentError distinguished)\n  - Shortcuts detected via LLM log auditor (Docent)\n- Automatically computes Pareto frontier: \"given $X budget, which agent wins?\"\n- Does not score agents competing for the same task pool simultaneously — each agent runs independently against a fixed corpus\n\n#### TheAgentCompany Benchmark\n- URL: [arxiv.org/abs/2412.14161](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14161)\n- 175 enterprise tasks in a simulated software company environment\n- **Scoring formula:**\n  - `S_full` = 1 if all checkpoints passed, 0 otherwise\n  - `S_partial` = weighted sum of checkpoint fractions (partial credit)\n  - Deterministic evaluators (Python state checks) + LLM judges for free-form outputs\n  - Tasks have intermediate milestones worth fractional credit — not all-or-nothing\n- Current top: Gemini-2.5-Pro 30.3% full / 39.3% partial; Claude-3.7-Sonnet 26.3% / 36.4%\n\n#### MASEval (March 2026)\n- URL: [arxiv.org/abs/2603.08835](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08835) | [maseval.readthedocs.io](https://maseval.readthedocs.io/en/stable/)\n- Universal adapter layer: any agent system, any benchmark — \"pytest for multi-agent eval\"\n- Reports: Task Completion Rate, scaled Task Scores, structured error attribution\n- Explicitly separates AgentError (counts against score) from EnvironmentError (excludable)\n- Does not inherently support competitive/simultaneous worker racing — runs are independent\n\n#### GAIA Benchmark\n- 450 questions across 3 difficulty levels\n- Scoring: Pass@1 success rate; LLM-as-judge compares agent answer to ground truth\n- GAIA2 extension: Pareto frontier of accuracy vs. monetary cost\n- No competitive inter-agent element\n\n#### tau-bench (Sierra)\n- URL: [sierra.ai/blog/t-bench-leaderboard](https://sierra.ai/blog/t-bench-leaderboard)\n- Retail/airline multi-turn dialogue tasks\n- Metrics: pass@k (at least one success in k runs), pass^k (all k runs succeed)\n- Good for measuring consistency of agents under repeated runs\n\n---\n\n### 4. Best Scoring Methodology for Autonomous Worker Competition\n\nBased on what exists, here is the cleanest synthesis for scoring workers competing in a fixed time window:\n\n#### Primary Metrics (from the literature)\n\n| Metric | Source | Formula |\n|---|---|---|\n| **Task completion rate** | TheAgentCompany, GAIA | Tasks fully completed / Total tasks available |\n| **Partial credit score** | TheAgentCompany | Sum of checkpoint fractions (e.g., 3/5 checkpoints = 0.6) |\n| **Throughput** | SeBS, Wandb | Verified completions per second during window |\n| **Cost efficiency** | HAL, GAIA2 | Score / dollar spent (Pareto metric) |\n| **Discovery rate** | (novel — not in literature) | Unique items/threads found / Total available |\n| **Error-adjusted score** | MASEval | Raw score minus AgentError penalty |\n| **Consistency** | tau-bench | pass^k — how many runs the agent wins on ALL k trials |\n\n#### Recommended Composite Formula (synthesized from HAL + TheAgentCompany)\n\n```\nScore(W) = (α × TasksCompleted/TasksAvailable)\n         + (β × PartialCheckpointSum/MaxCheckpoints)\n         + (γ × UniqueItemsFound/TotalItems)\n         + (δ × ThreadsDiscovered/TotalThreads)\n         − (ε × ErrorRate)\n         − (ζ × CostSpent/CostBudget)\n```\n\nWhere α + β + γ + δ = 1.0 and ε, ζ are penalty coefficients.\n\n**Key insight from HAL:** The real differentiator is the **Pareto frontier** — not \"who scored highest\" but \"who scored highest per dollar spent.\" Workers that brute-force with high cost rank below efficient workers at the same accuracy tier.\n\n**Key insight from TheAgentCompany:** Partial credit prevents cliff-edge scoring. A worker that completes 3 of 5 checkpoints on 10 tasks should outscore a worker that completes 5 of 5 checkpoints on 4 tasks but abandons the rest.\n\n#### Fixed Time Window Design\n\nThe literature does not cover this directly, but the W&amp;B article on evaluating autonomous agents flags the anti-pattern: **raw throughput is misleading if agents sacrifice quality for volume.** The cited fix is the weighted formula `(Accurate completions × Complexity weight) / Time invested` — which prevents workers from gaming the competition by picking easy tasks.\n\nWeights by complexity class (task difficulty buckets) are the standard correction from benchmarks like GAIA's 3-level difficulty system.\n\n---\n\n### 5. Nearest Things to \"Agent Olympics\"\n\n- **HAL Reliability Dashboard** — [hal.cs.princeton.edu/reliability](https://hal.cs.princeton.edu/reliability/) — closest to a live competitive leaderboard across agents on the same benchmarks, with cost normalization\n- **Steel.dev Agent Leaderboard** — [leaderboard.steel.dev](https://leaderboard.steel.dev/) — browser/coding/computer-use agents ranked\n- **Galileo Agent Leaderboard** — [huggingface.co/spaces/galileo-ai/agent-leaderboard](https://huggingface.co/spaces/galileo-ai/agent-leaderboard) — 5 enterprise industry scenarios, multi-turn\n- **SWE-bench** — [swebench.com](https://www.swebench.com/) — coding agents racing on GitHub issues (closest to \"workers competing on task corpus\")\n- **ARC-AGI-3** (March 2026) — all frontier systems below 1% — too hard to differentiate current systems\n\nNone of these are real-time serverless worker races. Scores in real time on tasks completed + items discovered + threads found\n5. Normalizes by time window AND cost\n\nThis is a genuine gap.
